cycles.method: Not measured. An event is one knob turn or YES on a BREAKCUT track: one line of up to 64 steps (bc_generate) and an in-place rewrite of the track record (bc_write), on the UI task, never in an interrupt and never while the pattern plays. Each UI tick also reads a few bytes for the input layer. To measure on a unit: the base's development cost stamps around the knob. Budget: one UI tick, 16.4 ms at 61 ticks a second, 4,330,000 cycles at 264 MHz.

load.method: Not measured. The module adds nothing to the frame interrupt and has no MIDI path; its only work is the knob turn above. Its retrigs are stock's, played by the sequencer.

stress.droppedExplanation: No flood ran: BREAKCUT sends and receives no MIDI. To run: BREAKCUT on eight Flex tracks at the busiest settings (ACTV and ROLL 127) at 240 BPM for 60 s, turning controls and changing Part, checking playback, the panel and USB.
